messages:
samar (Sales): FYI inbound security questionnaire from HorizonPay — they asked for completed SIG/CAIQ and some infra details. Need an owner for answers and a rough ETA. Link to doc: https://redwood.internal/horizonpay-q1 (view-only)
ashley (Security): tagging to queue — can we get scope: which environment will they hit (hosted vs dedicated vs private)? also do we have recent attestation PDFs? :thinking_face:
sec-intake-bot: New intake created and assigned to security-queue. Intake ID: INT-2025-4482. Please acknowledge within 4 business hours.
mike (Support): We have the SOC2 Type II PDF in the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/soc2-2024.pdf
mike (Support): Also have the data flow diagram (redact customer names) — I can drop it into the doc if that helps.
samar (Sales): They plan to use Hosted API in us-west; they asked specifically about data residency, key rotation, and encryption at rest.
ashley (Security): OK hosted api, us-west. I can take ownership of the questionnaire. ETA: draft answers by EOD tomorrow. Need confirmation on KMS provider and whether customer-managed keys are supported.
eva (Engineering): We use AWS KMS in us-west-2. We support CMK via Redwood Private only; Hosted API is our managed keys for now. We do allow customer-supplied certificates for TLS termination on Dedicated but not Hosted.
ashley (Security): Noted. Samar — pls confirm we communicate "Managed KMS (AWS) for Hosted; CMK available on Dedicated/Private" to the customer. I'll mark that in the SIG.
samar (Sales): Confirmed, will tell them. Also asking about incident response SLA and contact for security escalations.
ashley (Security): Our incident page link: https://redwood.internal/security/incident-response. For a customer-facing contact, we provide an enterprise security contact via a support/bizdev handoff — let me know if they need a named POC.
mike (Support): We normally provide a named security POC for Dedicated/Private deals. For Hosted, we give an on-call escalation email. I can draft the wording.
ashley (Security): Good. Two quick Qs in the SIG: 1) Are backups encrypted with a separate key? 2) Do we support client-side encryption for tokens? If anyone has short answers, paste here.
eva (Engineering): Backups are encrypted with AWS-managed keys, not a separate customer-managed key for Hosted. Client-side encryption of tokens is not supported out-of-the-box; customers can encrypt payloads before sending.
ashley (Security): Copy. I'll add those answers. Samar — can you push the doc access so I can edit? Current link is view-only.
samar (Sales): Done — changed permission to internal-edit. Added HorizonPay primary contact: j.lopez@horizonpay.com and timeline: they want answers within 72 hours.
ashley (Security): Acknowledged. Working on Q1-Q20 now. I'll mark the ones that need engineering verification.
sec-intake-bot: Reminder set for 48 hours for intake INT-2025-4482.
ashley (Security): Quick snippet for the SIG where we need to paste a certificate example:
```
Q: TLS cert rotation policy
A: We rotate TLS certs annually; emergency rotations as needed. Certificates are provisioned through our CA integration and monitored via cert-manager.
```
mike (Support): Draft for incident contact: "For escalations during normal business hours, contact security@redwood.com. For critical incidents, our on-call is reachable via pager: +1-555-0100." Suggest we send that.
samar (Sales): Looks good. I'll add to the response and send to customer once Ashley signs off.
ashley (Security): Will do final pass by tomorrow EOD. Assigning to myself in the intake system now.
eva (Engineering): FYI — there is a minor blocker on one question about KV-cache persistence (they asked retention). I can provide retention window: default 24 hours, configurable for Dedicated.
samar (Sales): Perfect. HorizonPay also asked about pen test reports. Any public summary we can share?
mike (Support): We have a redacted pen test exec summary — will upload it to the intake doc in 30m.
ashley (Security): Thanks. If all good, I'll mark intake INT-2025-4482 as "in progress" and set target completion 2025-08-12.
samar (Sales): Appreciate it. Please ping me if you need a sales vouch on slack with HorizonPay.
ashley (Security): Will do. :thumbsup:
